item.title: Welcome
item.description:
This site collects my research, commentary, and policy work on international trade — organised by theme rather than by publication type. Six hubs anchor it:

Brexit — what leaving the EU actually did to British trade, measured rather than argued.

Trade Wars — tariffs, export controls, and economic coercion as geopolitics rewrites the trade map.

Ukraine — exports, reconstruction, and whether an economy can win a war.

Firms — what trade policy and trade shocks do at the level of the firm.

Other — earlier and adjacent work on institutions, urban economics, and spatial econometrics.

Consultancy — the policy advisory work that runs alongside the academic research.

Posts here will track new papers, data findings, and commentary as they happen, each tagged into the relevant theme so the hub pages stay current. The RSS feed (top right) is the best way to follow along.
